source.name: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles
source.attribution: SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Global ETOPO1 terrain data: DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI, National Centers for Environmental Information, NESDIS, NOAA, U.S. Department of Commerce. Mapzen / Tilezen.
source.resampling: 0.1° footprint, 5×5 area-weighted bilinear source samples; rounded to whole metres. China land centers average land sub-samples only; negative coastal-fringe means and negative elevations outside the China land mask are set to sea level (0 m).
source.note: WGS84 geographic DEM, metres. Row 0 is south; columns run west to east. Approximately 10 km terrain sampling is a display support grid, not 10 km temperature observations. China land mask: local DataV/Amap province boundary (GCJ-02 converted to WGS84), SHA256 99adfeded5223848bbe37a0a12f8023e11ee12161c7800521c27db42fdeac275; offshore bathymetry is suppressed while below-sea-level China land is retained. Foreign terrain is not a supported display area. Source dates and resolution vary by dataset.
